row.body: A key ring is clipped to a list of trouble calls; each line is closed, but none has a caller’s name or a time to return.
row.title: The second access complaint

sidecar.gloss: Several calls are closed without callers or return times.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program office could close routine calls the same way; the missing details do not show who failed to answer.

row.body: the pocket calculator is tied to the first-aid kit by a clipped lanyard. an empty loop shows where an identifying tag was cut off.
row.title: missing count beside the pocket calculator

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
